# AccordionDetails

Details for Accordion

## Overview

- **Category**: surfaces
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: AccordionDetails

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { AccordionDetails } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<AccordionDetails>
  <Typography>Details content</Typography>
</AccordionDetails>
```

## Examples

```tsx

```
